bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 7, 9, 10. CRAZY EIGHTS presents on debut with a tongue tie already a part of his gear. He's been given two lead-up trials and this class suits at his first start. HARMONIOUS STRIDE trialed her in July before he won a subsequent trial at Casino. Ben Looker was aboard on both occasions and he should be treated with respect with Ben retaining the ride today. IBETTY endured too tough a run in transit here within this distance range on debut. Her unplaced effort must be forgiven. SIZZLING SUZIE was spelled after her solid debut effort at Port Macquarie. After trialing late last month on the same track, she's ready to tackle this trip at her first start back from a long spell.

raceTips.comment: Harmonious Stride has won a recent trial notably with Ben Looker riding who retains for his race day debut. Expecting the inside draw can be utilised. Crazy Eights has already been subject to market support likely owing to being related to Moonsweeper. Always respectfully of Dunn debutants. Sizzling Suzie has the benefit of prior race day experience which could prove all the difference. Monsieur Wolf sparks interest resuming gelded for a new stable but has no trials of late to reference.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 6, 9, 11. DANCE GAVIN DANCE overcame problems to win at Casino within this distance range. His race was fifty-four days ago but he's trialed here since and he can now have more to offer. RICH STAR is resuming after creating an impressive form card throughout his last preparation. He must be treated with respect here first up. THEIR FINEST HOUR was outclassed after a thirty-four day break last start at Randwick. This much quicker back-up will aid his cause when he now returns to the country circuit. DIVIDENDS PAID finished unplaced before excuses were immediately offered for his first up effort at Rosehill. He can regain his best form today without causing any surprises.

raceTips.comment: Their Finest Hour appeals. Didn't beat a runner home in a strong Highway race last time, but wasn't beaten here far two back and that was on the back of a dominant win prior. Sets up as the map horse of the race. Dance Gavin Dance was a gallant winner post let-up, has trialled since and now sports winkers. Rich Star has a compelling track/trip record and gets good weight relief with a claimer on. Dividends Paid pulled up lame post race last time so be forgiving. Don't be surprised to see sharp improvement.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 3, 6. JUNOSTAR performed above market place expectations third up at Casino and he can be expected to maintain his form today. He has raced well on this track before. BILLS ANGEL presents with numerous gear changes made and after winning a recent trial at Beaudesert, he's suitably placed in this class.  NUKATABE did a top job to finish as close to the winner as she did after a six week break last start at Casino. She had no luck when it counted most on the day. LAURIE'S QUILL who struck trouble here last run, clearly has scope to improve at only her third start in her first campaign whilst MOTION A NATION can be expected to appreciate a switch back from 1900m Casino last start. They are both in the mix today.

raceTips.comment: Incredibly thin maiden. Desert Angel appeals at the price. Ready to peak third up and profiles like the type that needs a trip like this to fire best. Junostar ran on well last start and a repeat effort should see her go close in this. Via that same race comes Motion A Nation who also worked home well late. Nukatabe ran an improved race last time which suggested another distance rise would prove suitable.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 9, 13, 14. DIVINE MANDATE did all but win when he was produced on debut at the Gold Coast last start  and he can atone for his costly defeat here at only his second run in a race. TOO MARS concedes race-day experience to all but she shouldn't be underestimated. She's trialed twice since a spell and she can cope over this testing trip on debut. ZWEIGELT begins his second campaign after trialing twice and he shouldn't be harshly njudged for either defeat before his spell. LATIN LIGHTS was produced for the first time since a stable change when she struck traffic problems first up at the Gold Coast. She can make a mockery of that unplaced effort today.

raceTips.comment: Divine Mandate was well supported on debut and was strong to/through the line when just missing. Fitter/further helps and he maps for a soft run. Latin Lights was solid first up for the new stable and looks ideally suited rising in distance. Where she settles in the run looks key. Zweigelt was kept very safe in betting in both runs last prep and showed ability. Has been given time to mature. Too Mars has shown ability at the trials and is drawn ideally.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 5, 11, 12. YOU ARE MIND raced greenly in transit before he finished unplaced at Eagle Farm last start. The addition of blinkers should aid his cause when he returns to Grafton today. He was a winner here at his previous outing. ALMANZAS  was presented for the second time since a spell and also since a stable change when he stepped up into this distance range last start at Moree. He scored with authority on the day and he can further progress today. TORQUE SO HOT looked the part after blinkers were added to his gear here third up and this race is also within his reach. NOZOMU led throughout fourth up at the Gold Coast and he's now more than ready to make a Grafton debut.

raceTips.comment: You Are Mind was a tough track/trip winner two back before struggling in stronger company over the mile last time out when kept safe in betting. Fitter again, dropping back in trip looks ideal for now. Stablemate Torque So Hot looks the danger on the back of a last start win. Almanzas appreciated the rise to this distance range last time out and is progressive enough to measure up. Nozomu has the widest barrier to overcome but with luck looks right in the mix.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 7, 10, 12. HUMPHREE BEAR has been produced twice since a stable change and since a spell. He made improvement at Coffs Harbour last start and he can further improve here. VALOURI resumes after two trials. She will soon prefer further but fresh, 1200m can still suit. KEIKO SAY had no luck at the Gold Coast when he was produced last start over 1400m. He's been kept fresh since and stepping back in distance shouldn't now be an issue.  SPIRITS BURN DEEP and WARRIOR BAE are others to be considered. BURN DEEP continues to maintain consistency whilst WARRIOR BAE handed in a gallant Gold Coast effort last start when he was produced over this journey.

raceTips.comment: Keiko Say had excuses at a crucial time in the run last start so arguably should have won. She doesn't look unsuited dropping back to 1200m, just may need some luck early to slot in from a sticky gate. Spirits Burn Deep hasn't won for a while but has been consistent of late and strikes a race to get back into winning form. Valouri resumes for a second prep after having shown ability last time in. Sets up to receive every chance in running. Humphree Bear next.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 8, 11. TARA KODA should not be harshly judged for an unplaced latest effort at Coffs Harbour. She became unsuited on transit and she can regain her best form when she returns to her home base today. ZUCCHERO struck traffic problems over only 1200m last start at Coffs Harbour. He's proven within this distance range and he has scope to improve today at his fourth start since a stable change and when he returns to his new home base. ANDROS was not disgraced after a forty-four day break at home (Casino) last start and this much quicker back-up should now aid his cause. AWARDED GLORY and IN THE FINE PRINT are others to be considered in an evenly matched contest to conclude the meeting.

raceTips.comment: Andros looks better placed back in this grading where he is always competitive. He also gets his regular rider back aboard and can utilise the inside draw. Tara Koda was solid two runs back before and even effort last time out. She tends to race well here. In The Fine Print sets up for a soft run and has a good record over this distance. Zucchero next.
